SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , D.DIARY_CONTENT AS diaryContent , D.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate , D.COUNT AS count , D.DIARY_STATUS AS diaryStatus , D.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , D.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , D.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , M.EMAIL AS email , D.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate , I.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo , I.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl , I.ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName , I.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , I.DIARY_NO AS imgDiaryNo FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_DIARY_IMAGE I ON D.DIARY_NO = I.DIARY_NO WHERE D.DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo} ORDER BY I.SORT_ORDER ASC
